comparisons.rationale: The stated split is self-consistent: 42 million is 90%, so 10% is 4.67 million (the video says 4.6); 4.6 million over 70% of 505,990 km2 is 13.0 per square km (13.2 with 4.67 million), about 7% below the stated "barely 14"; the statement is therefore approximately consistent. financial_checks.claim: 90% of the population (about 42 million) lives in 1,500 towns and cities on 30% of the land; 10% (4.6 million) on 70%; density barely 14 per square km
financial_checks.result: 42 / 0.9 = 46.7 million; 10% = 4.67 million; 4.6 million / (0.7 x 505,990 km2) = 13.0 per square km. Internally consistent; area split matches the usual statement; some outlets give 18 per square km.
Wrong: 20 November 1975; Juan Carlos proclaimed king 22 November 1975.

financial_checks.claim: Foreign workers are 13.3% of the pension pot; Spain passed 21 million contributors
financial_checks.result: Foreign affiliates 2,880,818 at end 2024 (news summaries of Ministry data); 2.88M / about 21.3M is about 13.5%. The transcript reads 133%, which is not a plausible share.

financial_checks.claim: Immigrants under 2% in 1998 and 15% in 2020; 135,000 Ukrainian refugees; employment growth 6.3% versus 2%; net migration of Ukrainians 86,000 in 2022
financial_checks.result: Not verified this session beyond order of magnitude.

financial_checks.claim: Life expectancy 84 now, projected highest in the world by 2040; median net income about 16,000 euros; unemployment lowest since 2008; AVE second-largest high-speed network after China; Madrid to Barcelona in 2h30
financial_checks.result: Plausible and widely reported; not re-fetched.

financial_checks.claim: A special tunnel was built to avoid upsetting the foundations of the Sagrada Familia
financial_checks.result: Contested: the rail tunnel near the cathedral drew protests about risk to the foundations; not verified here.

strengths: Clear explanation of why the rail network left villages behind.
Statistic block that is internally consistent.
weaknesses: Weak hook: a positive overview before the problem.
The solution is thin and generic, and the final paragraphs repeat.
Franco date reads 1979 in the transcript (wrong by four years); "133%" transcription defect.
Thumbnail does not communicate emptiness or the promise.
contradictions: Title promises a revival; the content describes an opportunity.
A national pension need for 200,000-250,000 migrants a year is used to argue rural resettlement, which does not follow.
A bright overview ("a country on the up") followed by "hides a secret".
improvement_opportunities: Open on the 14-per-square-km fact ("the size of 70% of Spain has fewer people than Madrid's metro area") instead of the country overview; a figure to check is needed before use.
Add one concrete case (a named village, a settlement programme and its cost) to pay the "realistic solution" promise.
Replace the thumbnail interior with an empty or hatched region and a population number so the map shows emptiness.
Correct Franco's death to 1975 and replace the "133%" with the audited share.
End with a question or a next video; there is no ask at present.
unavailable: Primary INE, Ministry of Territorial Policy and Social Security statistics
